full_judgment: The land of schedule-II along with other lands originally belonged to Abdur Rashid Chowdhury who settled the same in favour of one Mahfuzur Rabbi by Patta dated 19.05.1936. Mahfuzur Rabbi died leaving Jamaluddin and others as his heirs, accordingly, B.S. khatian (the latest records of right) stands recorded in the name of Jamaluddin and others, who by two kabalas dated 08.11.1978 sold the same to the brother of defendant No. 1, Md. Shawkat Alam. Subsequently, Shawkat Alam sold 10 decimals of land to the defendant No. 1 by kabala dated 16.06.1984. Said land is situated near Chakaria College. The plaintiff was looking for a piece of land in the said area to construct a house in order to provide accommodation to his children and grand children who were studying in Chakaria College and having come to know that the land of schedule II belonged to the defendant No. 1, was considered by him suitable to construct house and proposed the defendant to sell the said land to the plaintiff. The defendant considering the balance of convenience and inconveniences agreed to transfer the said land (schedule-II) by way of exchange with the suit land, accordingly, the plaintiff and the defendant No. 1 without being influenced or misrepresented by anybody executed and registered the deed of exchange on 13.03.1985 and delivered possession of their respective land to each other. The defendant by consolidating the land with the non-suited land (earlier purchased from Mostaque Ahmed) constructed semi pucca house thereon and planted fruit bearing trees and has been living thereon beyond the statutory period of limitation on payment of rents to the Government and Municipal taxes. On the other hand the plaintiff also having got the land of schedule-II bounded the same by fence and has been possessing by growing fruit bearing trees thereon. Since, the price of the suit land increased the same fell into the greedy eyes of the relatives of the plaintiff who with a view to grab the suit land managed the plaintiff to file the suit. The suit is false and frivolous and gambling in litigation, as such, prayed for dismissal of the suit.
